verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a model platform could expose an OpenAI-compatible endpoint or document a migration path from other SDKs. The only related claim, "a drop-in replacement is possible" (llama-docs-1/15), refers to swapping Llama 3.1 in for earlier Llama versions via a model-id change, not to compatibility with other providers. There is no evidence of an OpenAI-compatible API, adapter, or migration guide, and probes found no OpenAPI spec.
